layer_name: Distance to Nearby Property Types / Parcel Label
objective: Fix Parcel Label site visibility and the one-click single-runner recovery/smoke-test flow as one combined blocker before candidate production resumes.
acceptance_checks: Parcel Label is selectable in the Program Parcel Layer Matrix dropdown
the 6 real source-backed pilot rows are visible row-by-row
each row exposes source URL/path, evidence paths, accuracy, status, and changed marker
new and pending rows use visually distinct markers
the 88 prepared rows are not marked completed without real runner output
the Parcel Label current-changes panel is visible
visibility artifacts exist on the target branch and F portable web root
Tek Runner Baslat performs full recovery and smoke test with one click
repeated clicks do not start a second runner
panel PID equals lock PID equals heartbeat PID
heartbeat age is 60 seconds or less
the real runner creates the smoke artifact with generated_by_real_runner=true
artifact push succeeds and remote readback returns the same run_id and payload
the panel shows stage PASS/FAIL, artifact path, run_id, and commit SHA
candidate production remains paused until all checks pass
any failure writes an explicit blocker and does not increase progress
resume_rule: After combined acceptance proof exists, resume with a small batch of real internet-sourced Parcel Label candidates and expose them as NEW_PREPARED/PENDING_RUNNER before completion.
